rules.rationale: Android 16 headers retained the legacy RSA_padding_add_PKCS1_PSS and RSA_verify_PKCS1_PSS declarations but the main libcrypto binaries exported only the mgf1 forms. The port restores both entry points as eleven lines of thin wrappers that pass a null MGF1 digest to the existing implementations, matching the A13 Widevine ABI without duplicating cryptography.
rules.necessity: Required for Widevine or other legacy guest binaries that resolve the non-mgf1 RSA-PSS symbols from the platform libcrypto ABI.
rules.performance: One extra function call on the two legacy entry points. Compiler-generated wrappers are 11-56 bytes and delegate immediately; cryptographic cost and algorithm selection are unchanged.
rules.security: No new algorithm or validation path is introduced. The wrappers use the established BoringSSL default MGF1 digest behavior; future BoringSSL API removals must trigger symbol-level revalidation.
validation_evidence: readelf confirmed both legacy wrappers and both mgf1 implementations in 32-bit and 64-bit libcrypto.so.
Component commit 3408a53df9dfc88f18405e3d22a4cd5b92654282 and root commit 53333c898c30bad7455c3192329846d8ec209af9 record the port. Runtime DRM playback remains in the final boot gate.

rules.rationale: The promoted Android 16 BoringSSL integration already excludes the two vendor self-test init services removed by final A13. No additional source change is required.
rules.necessity: Necessary to preserve the verified guest boot-time policy and avoid launching unused SSL test services.
rules.performance: Avoids two test-service startups during boot and their process and I/O overhead.
rules.security: Removes test-only boot services from the production guest surface while leaving production BoringSSL self-test behavior unchanged.
validation_evidence: A13 init service removal and Android-16 vendor init_rc integration were compared directly; the services are not enabled in the target.
